{{nihongo|'''Shimotsuchikamano Shrine'''|下知我麺神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].
[[File:Atsuta_Hongu_oyobi_Setsu-Matsu-sha_no_Zu.png|alt=map of Atsuta Shrine|thumb]]
It is part of Atsuta Jingū
